zh: 亞哈隨魯和末底改的功績

p.src: 1  King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

en: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.
u.src: 1  King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

p.src: 2  Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

ja: 勢と武勇のすべての業、また
は、メディアとペルシアの
に記されているではないか。
en: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?
u.src: 2  Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

p.src: 3  For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

ja: モルデカイはアハシュエロス
en: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.
